free_features.f1_title: Sign up with just a username.
free_features.f1_text: No phone number, no email, no personal data. Choose a username and password — your account is ready in seconds.
free_features.f2_title: Verify who you're really talking to.
free_features.f2_text: Compare a security number derived from both parties' cryptographic keys, in person or by phone — the same defense Signal uses against man-in-the-middle attacks.
free_features.f3_text: Each device generates and keeps its own keys. Review, rename, or revoke access to any device in seconds, right from the app.
free_features.f4_title: Calls that never expose your IP.
free_features.f4_text: Audio and video always route through a relay — never a direct connection that would reveal your network to the other person.
free_features.f5_title: Private chats and groups, your way.
free_features.f5_text: Create rooms and invite friends via link or a dedicated password. Set messages to auto-delete, react with encrypted emoji, block or report anyone instantly.
free_features.f6_title: Your keys, protected — even in backups.
free_features.f6_text: Generated on your hardware, never on our servers. Your encrypted backup is locked with Argon2id, the memory-hard hashing OWASP recommends against GPU cracking.

business_features.f1_title: Activate your workspace with one token.
business_features.f1_text: Enter the license token, your company's name, and create the first administrator in minutes.
business_features.f2_text: The administrator assigns each collaborator a username and a temporary password. On first login, everyone sets their own — end-to-end encryption is active from message one.
business_features.f3_title: A structure that mirrors your company.
business_features.f3_text: Create departments, assign collaborators, and reorganize as roles or needs change — without ever touching message content.
business_features.f4_text: Define authorizations from a single room up to the entire organization, checked endpoint by endpoint — cross-workspace access is structurally blocked, not just discouraged.
business_features.f5_title: Encryption protects every conversation — even from admins.
business_features.f5_text: Messages are encrypted on devices before transmission. Not even a compromised administrator account can read their content.
business_features.f6_text: Sessions, devices, and administrative actions stay logged and auditable for accountability — while conversation content remains mathematically out of reach.

hero.subtitle: Every message is encrypted on your device before it ever leaves it — using the same Double Ratchet cryptography behind Signal and Matrix. Not a promise. Verified, endpoint by endpoint.

identity.title: Know exactly who you're talking to
identity.text: Compare a unique code, derived from both parties' cryptographic identity keys, in person or by phone. If it matches, no one has ever intercepted your connection — not even from the very first message.

protocol.title: Real cryptography, not a marketing claim
protocol.text: Palacan runs on the Olm and Megolm protocols — the same Double Ratchet cryptography that powers Signal and Matrix/Element. Every private key is generated and stored only on your device. The server never has the material required to read a single message.
protocol.olm: Powers one-to-one conversations. A new ratchet step on every message means compromising one message never compromises the next.
protocol.megolm: Powers group conversations. Each member holds their own sending session; membership changes rotate the room key automatically.
protocol.backup: Protects your encrypted backup with a password-derived key using the memory-hard, GPU-resistant hashing recommended by OWASP.

devices.title: One identity, every device
devices.text: Each device generates and keeps its own keys. Review, rename, or revoke access to any device in seconds — without ever exposing a private key to another device or to us.

calls.title: Calls that never leak your network
calls.text: Audio and video always route through a relay — never a direct peer-to-peer connection that would expose your IP address to the person on the other end.

security.title: Audited endpoint by endpoint, not just claimed
security.text: Before shipping, every route that touches user or company data was checked for cross-account and cross-workspace access — one by one, not sampled.
security.stat_keys: private keys ever touch our servers

safety_number.title: Verify {{peer}}'s identity
safety_number.explanation: Compare this number with the one your contact sees, in person or by phone. If it matches, you can be sure no one has got in the middle of your conversation.
safety_number.missing_key: Identity key not yet available for this contact - try again after exchanging at least one message.
safety_number.compute_error: Unable to compute the safety number.
safety_number.confirm_match: The numbers match, mark as verified
safety_number.qr_show_help: Let your contact scan this code from their phone, in their chat with you.
safety_number.qr_scan_help: Point the camera at the QR code on your contact's screen.
safety_number.qr_ok: Code correct: the scanned device is verified. Now do the opposite: your contact scans your code.
safety_number.qr_not_valid: This is not a Palacan verification code.
safety_number.qr_other_contact: This code belongs to someone else, not to the contact of this chat.
safety_number.qr_not_for_you: This code was created for a chat with someone else, not with you.
safety_number.qr_your_key_differs: WARNING: your contact's device does not see your real key. Someone may have got in the middle. Do not write anything confidential and warn your contact.
safety_number.qr_never_seen_key: WARNING: the key of the device you scanned is not any of those you are talking to. Unless your contact has just added a device, someone may have got in the middle. Exchange a message from that device and try again.
safety_number.qr_no_camera: No camera available on this device: choose a photo of the code.
safety_number.qr_camera_denied: Cannot use the camera (permission denied or busy): choose a photo of the code.
safety_number.qr_photo_none: No code found in the photo. Try again closer, with more light.
safety_number.v2_note: Calculated from the main keys: it is valid for all of your contact's signed devices, including those added later.
safety_number.qr_needs_master: Your contact uses the new verification (main key), but it is not ready here yet. Exchange a message and try again in a minute.
